title: Recolor Terracotta
description: Adds recipes to recolor previously-colored (non-glazed) terracotta!
body:
This is a simple little datapack that makes it easier to get the color of terracotta you want!

This pack adds recipes for every color of unglazed terracotta, allowing you to recolor any terracotta to a color you'd prefer. Do you have a surplus of red and blue but need a lot of green? Just recolor it with these new recipes!

Glazed terracotta CANNOT be recolored; once you've thrown your terracotta in the furnace, the color is locked in!
